verdict.rationale: PostHog's hosted MCP server documents a Feature flags tool family of 27 tools and says agents can "ship a feature flag from a prompt." Agent targeting is shown in the documented Slack/MCP example that rolls a flag out to users with a given email property, and flags support person, cohort, and group targeting. Agent-driven toggling (turning a flag off or changing rollout through the API or MCP) is not explicitly documented; the turn-off capability appears only as a general product feature, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of toggling or updating a flag through the API or MCP tools, a per-tool reference for the flag tools (create, update, delete), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent flag management.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent create, target, and toggle feature flags through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: with just plain text questions your agents can ship a feature flag from a prompt
